title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (NVFP4) with DSpark
description: NVIDIA's hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE (30B, 3B active), NVFP4, DSpark speculative decoding (block 3), tool calling and reasoning. Checked on the Jetson AGX Thor 2026-09-28: 17*23 answered 391, an iterative fib(n) written correctly, about 130 tokens/s, ready 8 minutes after a first start (FlashInfer autotune).
source: Parameters from Mia's AI Lab (github.com/MiaAI-Lab/Nemotron3.5-Lightning-DGX-Spark-RTX-5090-6000-PRO), on LMSYS's SGLang image for this model, which includes sm_110
